result.title: Efficient Closure Learning in Dynamical Systems: A Comparison of Data-Assimilated and Embedded Approaches
result.summary: Increased computing power has transformed computational science and improved predictive capabilities for complex systems, but many phenomena still exceed current simulation capabilities or require rapid evaluations for fast design iterations. Closure models address this challenge by approximating unresolved effects in reduced or incomplete dynamical systems. Data-driven closures offer a flexible mechanism for improving model accuracy and applicability, but approaches that embed the closure within a computational model for construction and training phases can be computationally expensive and cause numerical instabilities in the computational model during training. To avoid the challenges posed by embedded approaches, staged approaches to closure-model learning have been developed. The first stage uses data assimilation to infer state and closure trajectories from observations. The second stage trains a machine learning closure model offline using the assimilated data, thereby avoiding repeated simulator calls during training. In this work, we investigate the cost and accuracy tradeoffs between embedded and staged data-driven closure modeling approaches for a synthetic epidemiological SIQR model with a nonlinear state-dependent quarantine closure. The results illustrate a practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off: for this exemplar, embedded training provides the strongest average accuracy, while the staged approach yields comparable qualitative behavior with a moderate increase in error, substantially fewer model evaluations, and improved optimization robustness.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在合成 SIQR 流行病模型上比较「嵌入式」与「分阶段」两类数据驱动 closure 建模：分阶段方法先用数据同化从观测推断状态与 closure 轨迹，再离线训练 ML closure，以避免训练中反复调用模拟器引发的高成本与数值不稳定。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先用数据同化推断不可观测量、再离线训练」的两阶段流程，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的构造与监督提供线索（如何避免训练时反复昂贵前向、如何保证轨迹优化稳健），但属跨领域线索，可供核查其可迁移性。
